dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: She glances up but never clearly sees his face. Just a glimpse of a faded BGA hoodie. He walks away, clutching her original Tamagotchi.

dialog.speaker: oldRonnie
dialog.text: No problem. Hang on to that. It may save your life someday.

dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: She stands there a moment, then pockets the Tamagotchi and heads home.
